bucket_note: Open yearly files (2011-2025), record-level, GPS on every crash, person KABCO, linked tables. Catch: no reuse licence.

sources.name: SD DPS Office of Accident Records, Raw Crash Data (SDARS files)
sources.url: https://www.safesd.gov/ (Download Crash Data > Raw Crash Data); https://www.safesd.gov/downloads/raw-data/SDARSFiles<year>.zip
sources.access: open (zip per year, no login; 'Data updated April 15 annually')
sources.licence_text: safesd.gov: 'Vehicle crash reports are covered by South Dakota open records statute'; footer 'Copyright ©2022 South Dakota Department of Public Safety. All Rights Reserved.' No reuse licence for the raw data.
sources.kabco: yes: Person.InjuryStatusDesc (Fatal injury / Incapacitating / Non-incapacitating / Possible / No injury); crash Severity Fatal/Injury/PDO

placement_sample.note: auto_share is 0 under the default Gate() because the network is TIGER-only; within_250ft is scored under Gate(tiger_only_auto=True), against the hidden GPS. House addresses not measured.

end_to_end.corridor: S Minnesota Ave, W 41st St to W 57th St, Sioux Falls
